what_it_is: AI-native accounting software: AI does the bookkeeping from bank and credit card statements inside a double-entry general ledger. A financial document converter is included.
plans_and_list_prices: One plan with General Ledger and Converter: $149 a month billed monthly, or $79 a month billed annually ($948 a year), with 1,000 Converter pages a month. Larger page plans: 2,500 pages $249 monthly or $179 billed annually; 5,000 pages $599 monthly or $449 billed annually.
billing_note: Monthly or annual billing. Annual billing gives the year's 12,000 pages upfront.
free_trial: 7 days; a card at checkout, nothing charged for 7 days.
bank_connections: No live bank feeds. Transactions come from uploaded bank and credit card statements, each proven against its printed balances.
ai_features: Categorizes from each client's reviewed history, matches bills and invoices to payments, reconciles each month, drafts month-end entries for review, asks when it isn't sure, and anything it did can be undone.
human_service: Done-for-you bookkeeping by the ZeraBooks team, from $150 a month (USD), priced after a free call.
multi_entity: 3 active client companies included; each additional active client $29 a month, or $290 a year on annual billing.
statement_documents: Reads PDF bank, card, check and brokerage statements (up to 500 pages a file) and proves each account against its printed balances. Excel and CSV downloads, including QuickBooks-, Xero- and Sage-ready CSV layouts.
